Since Bun 1.4.4, a server only asks for a client certificate with `requestCert: true`, as in Node.js. `ca` alone used to be enough, so a server that relied on it now accepts clients without a certificate.

The rule checks `Bun.serve()`, `Bun.listen()` and a server that is the default export.

`--fix-suggestions` adds `requestCert: true`.

`bun lint --upgrade` runs this rule. See [Upgrade Bun](/lint#upgrade-bun).

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"bun/tls-require-request-cert" = "error" # or "warn"
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}
```ts
Bun.serve({ tls: { key, cert, ca }, fetch: handle });
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```ts
Bun.serve({ tls: { key, cert, ca, requestCert: true }, fetch: handle });
Bun.serve({ tls: { key, cert, ca, requestCert: false }, fetch: handle });
await fetch(url, { tls: { ca } });
```
